dateLabel: probably built under Ptolemy II (r. 285-246 BCE)
title: Library of Alexandria
summary: Part of a research institute called the Mouseion, the library collected huge numbers of papyrus scrolls.
why: One of the largest and most important libraries of the ancient world.

notes.problem: Source: established 'Possibly during the reign of Ptolemy II Philadelphus (285-246 BC)' and 'probably not built until the reign of his son'. Label states it as certain and uses 284.
